data.body: Root cause confirmed (measured + read from code). heal_multi_bundle resolves the remote with plain 'git remote get-url' (s3_doctor.py:77), which returns the fetch URL; the URL's user@ segment becomes the git-remote-s3 profile (parse_git_url -> S3Remote -> boto3.Session(profile_name)). Red tests written before the fix, run on 3b80ff04452: 6 fail as expected. test_heal_writes_under_the_push_url_of_a_split_remote: factory received s3://tickets-reader@... not the writer URL. Split-scheme push preflight (sync + async): no OptionalDependencyError raised. Inverse (s3 fetch, https push): push wrongly fails closed. Init [push-side s3]: no raise. Completion delivery: preflight passed and reached the push ('completion delivery push failed: push intercepted'). Init [fetch-side s3] already passes (regression guard). Fix next: --push at the 4 write-path sites, both URLs at init.
